query:
UPDATE releases
            SET status = $3,
                risk = $4,
                notes = $5,
                rollout_percentage = $6,
                rollout_plans = $7,
                rollout_pilot_organisations = $8,
                minimum_operator_version = $9,
                steps_through = $10,
                updated_at = $11
            WHERE kind = $1 AND version = $2
